nodes.label: Authentication Flow (Pass-Through Proxy)
nodes.rationale: Next.js acts as a transparent frontend layer. FastAPI handles auth via HTTPBearer. Original headers including Authorization are proxied. No secrets are exposed to the client bundle.

nodes.label: API Proxy Pattern
nodes.rationale: All /api/* routes proxy to the FastAPI backend to avoid CORS, allow future header injection for auth/rate-limiting/logging, and isolate secrets as server-side env vars.

nodes.label: Dual-Stream Frontend
nodes.rationale: SSE carries all phase data and events. WebSocket is used ONLY for control signals such as stop and status to avoid double-processing.
